paper.title_en: $θ$ Angle and Axial Anomaly in Holographic QCD
paper.abstract_en: We present a bottom-up holographic description of the QCD $θ$-vacuum and the $U(1)_A$ anomaly in five dimensions. The multi-branched $θ$-vacuum structure emerges geometrically from a higher-dimensional gauge field, while the axial anomaly is realized through a Stückelberg coupling that is dual to a Chern-Simons term. In this framework, the $η'$ meson appears as a zero mode of bulk fluctuations, and its mass arises from the anomaly-induced Stückelberg term. The construction provides a transparent holographic derivation of the anomaly contribution to the $η'$ mass and naturally reproduces the Witten-Veneziano relation between the $η'$ mass and the Yang-Mills topological susceptibility.
